texts.title: The Last World Lost
texts.body: {self.house} holds no world now. It keeps its name, its people, its friends and its debts, and it has lost the thing that made it a house of land. Houses have come back from this, by the roads every new name walks: a command by service, under Military; a marriage into a house with land, under Dynasty; a grant of a world petitioned for, under Worlds; or the money to buy one, under House, Purses and the will. The household is waiting to hear what you say.

choices.swear_to_hold_land_again: Swear before the household that the house will hold land again.
choices.say_nothing_and_work: Say nothing. Go back to work in the morning.
choices.a_house_is_its_people: Tell them a house is its people, not its worlds.
